answer: Replica operators fail a one-window silt-gate trial. After locking 22.7 POA, the applicant has 23 minutes to stand on jetty piling JP-08, aim handheld mirror HM-14 at beacon B-6 until logger LG-3 records a 0.8° lock for 48 seconds, then release dye puck DP-2 into river mile RM-11 so sampler S-9 captures 140 ml with turbidity under 9 NTU. A second attempt from the same key cluster, a lock wider than 1.5°, or a reused puck burns the 22.7 POA and bars gate keys for four epochs. Two hydrology clerks recompute the logger and bottle seal.
